en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view taken from a field toward a small European town nestled in a valley. In the foreground is a cultivated field, then a few detached houses along a lane. Farther back stand several large institutional buildings with mansard or steep roofs and a prominent multi‑storey wing on the left. Near the center‑right of the town is a church with a tall spire; other church‑like buildings with towers appear nearby. The town is surrounded by forested hills in the background. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.
